questions.question: Refer the below table and answer the question that follows. Discipline Boys Girls Engineering 120 80 Medical 80 120 What percentage of students who chose medical are boys?
questions.questionHtml:
Refer the below table and answer the question that follows.

Discipline Boys Girls
Engineering 120 80
Medical 80 120

 

What percentage of students who chose medical are boys?
questions.solution:
Given:

Discipline: Medical

Boys in Medical = 80

Girls in Medical = 120

Formula Used:

Percentage of boys in Medical = (Number of boys in Medical / Total number of students in Medical) × 100

Calculation:

Total number of students in Medical = Boys in Medical + Girls in Medical

Total number of students in Medical = 80 + 120 = 200

Percentage of boys in Medical = (80 / 200) × 100

Percentage of boys in Medical = 0.4 × 100 = 40%

The percentage of students who chose medical and are boys is 40%.

Cars/Years 2022 2023 2024 X 2560 3201 3551 Y 2250 2802 3020 Z 2750 2550 2600 What is the average number of cars manufactured by the company in the year 2024?

Cars/Years 2022 2023 2024

What is the average number of cars manufactured by the company in the year 2024?
questions.solution:
Given:

The number of cars manufactured over three years is as follows:

Cars/Years 2022 2023 2024
X 2560 3201 3551
Y 2250 2802 3020
Z 2750 2550 2600

Formula used:

Average = (Total cars manufactured in 2024) / (Number of car types)

Calculations:

Total cars manufactured in 2024 = Cars of type X + Cars of type Y + Cars of type Z

= 3551 + 3020 + 2600

= 9171

The average number of cars manufactured by the company in the year 2024 is 3057.

Year B1 (in lakhs) B2 (in lakhs)
2004 195 284

Formula used:

Total sales ratio = Total sales of B1 ÷ Total sales of B2

Calculations:

Total sales of B1 = 195 + 230 + 250

questions.question: The given table shows the marks obtained by a student in class 9. What is the percentage of marks obtained by the student? Subjects Marks(out of 100) Social Science 93 Science 90 Hindi 90 English 95 Mathematics 78
questions.questionHtml:
The given table shows the marks obtained by a student in class 9.

What is the percentage of marks obtained by the student?

Subjects Marks(out of 100)
Social Science 93
Science 90
Hindi 90
English 95
Mathematics 78
questions.solution:
Given:

Marks obtained by the student:

Social Science = 93

Science = 90

Hindi = 90

English = 95

Mathematics = 78

Formula Used:

Percentage of marks = (Total marks obtained / Total maximum marks) × 100

Calculation:

Total marks obtained = 93 + 90 + 90 + 95 + 78

Total marks obtained = 446

Assume the maximum marks per subject = 100.

Total maximum marks = 5 × 100 = 500

Percentage of marks = (446 / 500) × 100

Percentage of marks = 89.2%

The percentage of marks obtained by the student is 89.2%.
